name: lw-lms-admin
description: LW LMS admin UI (React, WordPress components).

scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/lw-lms.pot --slug=lw-lms --domain=lw-lms --exclude=node_modules,vendor,src,tests,docs --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://github.com/lwplugins/lw-lms/issues"}' && msgmerge --quiet --update --backup=none --no-fuzzy-matching languages/lw-lms-hu_HU.po languages/lw-lms.pot && msgfmt languages/lw-lms-hu_HU.po -o languages/lw-lms-hu_HU.mo && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
